The successful Boilermaker candidates will need to have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a similar role, and hold a relevant trade qualification, along with –

* Experience repairing quarry fixed and mobile plant
* Be proficient in various welding application including – Arc, Mig, Wire feed etc

* Be prepared to travel predominantly within the Pilbara region to service our quarry and concrete operations
* Have a strong understanding and commitment to OH&S
* Ability to work independently
* An excellent mechanical aptitude
* Sound problem solving and decision-making skills

* Detecting and diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults in engines and parts

* Complies with applicable Safety, Environment, Health, and Waste Management policies and procedures
* Repairing and replacing worn and defective parts, reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed

* Reassembling engines and parts after being repaired
* Testing and adjusting mechanical parts after being repaired for proper performance
* Diagnosing and testing parts with assistance of computer

Our client, JAPMANN SERVICES PTY LTD, is seeking a highly organised and proactive FLEET MANAGER to oversee vehicle operations, including assessing needs, negotiating leases/purchases, and managing maintenance. The role involves providing expert advice, maintaining accurate records, and implementing cost-saving strategies. The ideal candidate will also handle driver recruitment, vehicle registration, and ensure compliance with safety and legal standards. If you're passionate about optimizing fleet performance and efficiency.

Duties: 
o	Determine vehicle requirements by assessing type, load capacity, fuel efficiency, safety features, cargo space, and Tracking systems to align with operational needs.
o	Source and negotiate the purchase or lease of vehicles, securing favourable terms including pricing, financing, service packages, and warranties.
o	Coordinate the sale or disposal of outdated or damaged fleet vehicles through trade-ins, resales, or scrapping, ensuring optimal returns within budget constraints.
o	Oversee maintenance and servicing schedules to ensure vehicles remain in top working condition, minimizing downtime and extending lifespan.
o	Monitor and control vehicle usage and costs related to fuel, repairs, insurance, and overall operational efficiency.
o	Provide expert recommendations to rental agencies and leasing companies regarding vehicle selection, acquisition, and management, utilizing industry insights to support efficient operations.
o	Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle transactions, including purchase agreements, lease details, registrations, service logs, insurance, and disposal documentation.
o	Conduct market research to identify trends and shifts in the vehicle rental and leasing industry, using insights to enhance competitiveness and inform strategic decisions.
o	Assist in hiring qualified drivers by assessing skills, experience, and adherence to safety standards.
o	Develop and manage driver schedules to maximize fleet utilization, meet delivery timelines, and minimize idle time.
o	Take care of registering and licensing all vehicles in the fleet, making sure they follow all local, state, and national laws. Keep all documents current and accurate. Stay updated on any changes in government rules and make necessary adjustments to fleet operations to avoid any legal problems.
o	Monitor driver behaviour and performance through tracking systems and feedback, ensuring safety, efficiency, and customer service standards.

•	AQF Diploma or Higher
•	1-2 years of experience in related field

Salary: 
•	$80,000 - $100,000 + Superannuation

Working conditions: 
•	Full Time
•	38 hours per week

result.description:
The Newman Hotel is a renowned hospitality provider in the heart of the Pilbara region, offering exceptional accommodation, dining, and event facilities to both locals and visitors. We are committed to delivering outstanding customer service and creating a welcoming and enjoyable experience for all our guests.

About the Role
We are seeking a passionate and skilled Chef to join our dynamic kitchen team. In this role, you will work closely with our Executive Chef and Head Chef to prepare and present high-quality dishes for both our restaurant and function services.

Key Responsibilities
•	Follow the guidance and instructions of the Executive Chef and Head Chef, contributing to a collaborative and efficient kitchen environment.
•	Prepare and cook a wide range of dishes in large quantities for daily service and special events, ensuring consistent quality and adherence to recipes.
•	Strictly adhere to the Food Safety Plan and Australian Food Safety Regulations, maintaining a high standard of hygiene and food safety practices.
•	Meticulously prepare mise en place for service, ensuring all ingredients and equipment are readily available and organized for efficient workflow.
•	Monitor the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation, ensuring consistent adherence to Hotel Newman's high standards.
•	Inspect kitchen equipment and work areas to ensure they are sanitary and ready for operation, maintaining a clean and safe working environment.
•	Introduce new culinary skills and techniques to the team, contributing to ongoing learning and development within the kitchen.

Skills and Experience
•	Formal culinary qualifications or equivalent experience.
•	Proven experience in a similar role within a high-volume, quality-focused kitchen.
•	Excellent culinary skills and a passion for creating delicious food.
•	Strong understanding of food safety and hygiene practices.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Ability to work under pressure and maintain a positive attitude.   

Benefits
•	Competitive salary in line with the Hospitality Award ($79,423 per annum).
•	Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team in a renowned establishment.
•	Contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests.

To Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and skills to hr@acuream.com.au

We offer on-site accommodation and meals to our staff. This is not a FIFO position.

result.description: LEADCON TECH PTY LTD   Role Summary   Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is seeking a seasoned SAP Supply Chain Professional with over 10 years of experience in end-to-end SAP ECC and S/4HANA implementations, global rollouts, and Center of Excellence (CoE) roles. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in SAP MM, WM, and Procurement, with strong cross-module integration across SD, PP, PM, FICO, PS, and MDG. Experience in Oil & Gas, Energy, or large-scale industrial sectors is highly valued.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation and migration projects for procurement, inventory, and warehouse management.  Work with users to formulate and document business requirements, and translate them into functional system specifications.  Identify, investigate, and analyze business processes, procedures, and work practices to recommend optimal system solutions.  Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements in system functionality, behavior, and business practices.  Develop project plans, cost estimates, and resource allocation using project management methodologies.  Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including creating system test plans to ensure quality and integrity.  Create user and training documentation, and conduct formal training classes for end users and key stakeholders.  Develop functional specifications for use by system developers and technical teams.  Use data and process modeling techniques to create clear system specifications for design and development.  Act as a central reference and information source, providing guidance in system project decision-making.  Manage integration with third-party tools such as Jagger (eProcurement), IBP, MDG, SharePoint, and barcoding systems.  Embed compliance frameworks (e.g., Manual of Authority) into procurement workflows.  Lead change requests, system enhancements, and continuous improvement roadmaps.    Key Skills    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities  Excellent written and verbal communication skills  Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities  Proficiency in data and process modeling techniques  Experience with project management methodologies (SCRUM, Kaizen)  Attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented approach  Deep SAP S/4HANA Procurement and MM configuration skills  Cross-module integration expertise  User training, documentation, and workshop facilitation    Qualification & experience   Qualifications & Experience    Qualifications:   Bachelor's degree in Computer Software Engineering or related field. SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP MM and Ariba certifications are strongly preferred.   Experience:    10+ years in SAP MM, WM, and Supply Chain roles  Minimum 5+ years in S/4HANA implementations and upgrades  Proven experience in Oil & Gas, Energy, or large industrial sectors  Experience leading global template rollouts and cross-functional teams    Language Requirement:   Fluent in English (written and spoken)  About Company    Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is an Australian proprietary company limited by shares, registered with the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ACN 664 795 902) in New South Wales since January 2023. Headquartered at Spring Farm, NSW, the company operates under the leadership of its director, Rakesh Kumar. As a growing enterprise in the technology space, Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is committed to building strong operational foundations and expanding its capabilities to meet evolving industry demands.
